purpose: Machine-readable behavioral governance invariants for 3.2. This registry defines checks; it does not authorize architecture changes.

invariants.name: exactly-one-authoritative-writer
invariants.rule: Every governed mutable infrastructure object declares exactly one primary owner.

invariants.name: generation-required
invariants.rule: Every authoritative mutable object declares an explicit generation or epoch contract.

invariants.name: worker-topology-locked
invariants.rule: The active topology remains exactly W01-W06 unless Worker Admission is explicitly satisfied.

invariants.name: binding-authority
invariants.rule: Provider/resource bindings have exactly one declared authority and the current baseline authority is W06.

invariants.name: control-plane-bootstrap-safety
invariants.rule: No runtime bootstrap dependency may require W06 synchronously.

invariants.name: dependency-acyclicity
invariants.rule: The governed dependency graph must be acyclic.

invariants.name: historical-isolation
invariants.rule: Historical 1.x/2.x/legacy material cannot become active authority through an ordinary governed change.

invariants.name: change-scope-closed
invariants.rule: Actual Git diff must equal the declared Change Manifest file scope.

invariants.name: no-false-pass
invariants.rule: Behavioral governance must emit PASS only after every required invariant check completes successfully.
